name: Associated Students, Inc., California State University, Fullerton
orgTypeBasis: The student-body auxiliary of a CSU campus with its own board, its own staff and its own budget; it runs the Titan Student Union and Titan Recreation as its own operations, which is why it signs contracts a campus department would have to route through procurement.
address: 800 N State College Blvd, Fullerton, CA 92831
decisionMakerTitle: ASI Student Leadership & Programs Coordinator (professional staff advisor, never the elected officer)
whyTheyFit: ONE CAMPUS IS NOT ONE CUSTOMER. ASI's own site describes it representing over 45,000 students and running the Titan Student Union, Titan Recreation, student government and campus-wide programming - underneath that sit hundreds of recognised student organisations, greek chapters and sport clubs, each with its own small budget and its own reason to go somewhere, and the ASI professional staff is the one door that reaches all of them at once through an org-fair table or a single email to club presidents. The officers change every May; the coordinator who actually signs does not, which is why the relationship is built with the advisor and not with whoever won the election.
buyingWindow: Aug-Sep for welcome week and the org fairs, Apr-May for chapter banquets, awards nights and officer transition
headcountBasis: Modeled on the shape of a 45,000-student campus rather than a roster: a single club night is 20-40, a greek chapter 50-120, an ASI-run all-campus programme several hundred. No booking-level count is published.
note: This is a different buyer from the CSU Fullerton row already on the board. That row is the university's Student Life & Leadership office; this is the incorporated student association with its own money. Work both, and never let them find out you pitched them the same night at two different prices.
addressSource: Associated Students, Inc. website, asi.fullerton.edu, read 14 August 2026.
excludeReason: Directional disagreement. The campus address ASI publishes is 800 N State College Blvd; the Census 2020 geocoder returns 800 S STATE COLLEGE BLVD, FULLERTON on both the zip-qualified and the simplified form - the opposite directional and a different segment of the road, roughly where the Howmet plant on this wave's industrial list sits. That is the same failure that took Round One Entertainment off this board, so no coordinate is recorded here even though the campus is obviously real and the board's existing CSU Fullerton row already carries a Places-derived pin for it.

orgTypeBasis: One of eleven campuses listed on the college's own locations page across California and Utah, so programme calendars and spending approvals run through a campus director inside a group, not through an independent school.
